item.title: Kelly Kelly Reacts to WWE 2K26 Roster Snub
item.description: Kelly Kelly (Barbara Jean Blank) voices her disappointment on X about not being included in WWE 2K26. The former Divas Champion jokes about starting a petition.

item.title: Kiana James on Pinning Charlotte Flair: "Iron Sharpens Iron"
item.description: Kiana James describes pinning Charlotte Flair as "bittersweet" after the two trained together through injury rehab, and opens up on her mentor network inside WWE.

item.title: Kiana James on Injury Comeback: "Let It Define Me or Use It"
item.description: Kiana James reflects on her 2024 knee injury, revealing she used the downtime to study decades of wrestling film and made herself a promise to return stronger.

item.title: AEW Star Pulled From Dynamite, Indie Dates Due to Health Issue
item.description: Eddie Kingston has been pulled from tonight's AEW Dynamite in Denver and independent bookings this week while dealing with severe migraine headaches.

item.title: WWE Tryout Attendee Regina Tarin Makes UFC Debut This Saturday
item.description: Regina Tarin, who attended WWE's January 2026 Performance Center tryout, makes her UFC debut this Saturday at UFC Mexico City on short notice against Ernesta Kareckaite.

item.title: WWE Surpasses UFC in Annual Revenue for First Time Under TKO
item.description: WWE generated $1.709 billion in 2025 revenue — topping UFC's $1.502 billion for the first time. Every revenue category grew, with media rights crossing $1 billion thanks to Netflix and ESPN.

item.title: Timothée Chalamet Credits WWE as "Hugely Influential" to Acting Career
item.description: Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet says professional wrestling shaped his acting career, citing The Boogeyman, Sabu, and Kevin Nash as personal favorites.

item.title: British Bulldog's WWE Hall of Fame Ring Stolen
item.description: Davey Boy Smith Jr.'s British Bulldog WWE Hall of Fame ring, Hart Foundation leather vest, and other irreplaceable wrestling items were stolen from his trailer, per Diana Hart Smith.
